_comment: Planned node configure detail for searchProducts1. Run the command below once a live WooCommerce connection is available.
_command: uip maestro flow node configure DTLLoadByDefaultFalseTest.flow searchProducts1 --detail "$(cat searchProducts1.detail.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); del d["_comment"]; del d["_command"]; print(json.dumps(d))')" --output json

_field_notes.attribute: Dropdown with loadByDefault:true — resolves against /attributes (objectName: /attributes). Pass attribute ID chosen by the caller.
_field_notes.attribute_term: Dropdown with loadByDefault:FALSE — loads on demand only after 'attribute' has a value. Reference path: /attributes/terms?attribute_ID={attribute}. displayPattern: {name} - {id}. Design shows this field only when 'attribute' is set (fieldActions: show when attribute has any value, hide when attribute is cleared). The caller passes the term ID selected from the on-demand dropdown.
